name: ban.do
notes: Store meta: Bowling Green, Kentucky, USD, ships to US and CA; 'ban.do curates and creates products that are meant to make you smile' (https://bando.com/meta.json). About: 'In 2008 we created ban.do' (https://www.bando.com/pages/about-us).

Its bags collection is mostly other labels (243 of 301 listings are Baggu, plus Free People and others): only vendor 'ban.do' items counted, Baggu collaborations excluded, leaving 9 regular-price own-label bags.

Free standard shipping in the contiguous USA on orders $75+ (https://www.bando.com/policies/shipping-policy). Returns within 30 days unless final sale, $5.95 fee deducted (https://www.bando.com/policies/refund-policy).

Named: Quilted Tote - Blue Scandinavian Floral $29.95 ('Quilted exterior cotton material', quilted nylon interior, 15 x 17 x 4 in.), Quilted Tote - Pink Tile Floral $29.95, Canvas Tote Bag - Library Card $20.95 (cotton canvas), Rattan Market Bag - Fruit Tiles $45.95.
Mix of the 9 own-label regular-price bags (2026-10-29): 7 totes and 2 market bags; no crossbody or backpack (https://www.bando.com/collections/bags/products.json?limit=250).

prices.note: https://www.bando.com/collections/bags/products.json feed, 301 listings: 4 marked down and 0 sold out excluded, 288 out-of-scope items excluded; 9 regular-price bags, median $29.95. Low / mid / high: Canvas Tote Bag - Library Card $20.95; Quilted Tote - Blue Scandinavian Floral $29.95; Rattan Market Bag - Fruit Tiles $45.95. Like-for-like: carry bags at regular price, in stock (totes, shoulder and crossbody bags, satchels, hobos, belt/hip bags, backpacks); luggage, duffels and weekenders, lunch bags, diaper/baby bags, pouches, wallets, wristlets, cosmetic cases, straps, charms, coolers, pet and kids' items excluded.
